zh.title: 上市营销策略：从定价到上市第一周怎么安排
zh.seo_title: 卖房上市营销策略怎么规划｜陈靖
zh.description: 上市营销不是把房源发出去就结束。本文说明如何找准房子的真实卖点、安排上市节奏、写好房源描述，遵守公平住房和图片规定，并根据看房数据调整策略，避免常见错误。
zh.lead: 好的上市计划会先想清楚买方在比较什么、房子有什么可以说的，再安排什么时候、用什么方式让人看到。

en.title: Listing Marketing Plan: From Pricing to the First Week
en.seo_title: How to Plan a Home Listing Marketing Strategy | Jing Chen
en.description: A listing plan is more than posting a home online. Find real selling points, set the timing, follow fair housing rules and read the feedback.
en.lead: A good listing plan starts with what buyers will be comparing and what can honestly be said about the home, and then works out when and how they will see it.
